standard.summary: FSDP2 下保存/加载 state 的形式：full（默认，聚合成一份完整 state）或 sharded（每张卡各存自己那片）。
standard.effect: 决定 StateDictOptions(full_state_dict=) 的取值。full 由 rank0 聚合出与单卡训练同形状的完整 state；sharded 每个 rank 各存各的分片，体积小、保存快，但只有 DCP（torch.distributed.checkpoint）加载器读得懂。
standard.whenToUse: 默认 full。除非确定后续加载走 DCP、且卡数不变，否则不要选 sharded。
standard.avoidWhen: 要把产物拿去单卡推理、或用普通 torch.load 读，就必须是 full。sharded 产物换了卡数就对不上。

optionDescriptions.full: 保存前把分片聚合成完整 state dict（默认）。这是普通检查点加载器唯一读得懂的形式。
optionDescriptions.sharded: 每个 rank 各存自己那片。省内存峰值，但产物只有 DCP 那套接口读得回来。

standard_en.summary: The form in which state is saved and loaded under FSDP2: full (the default, gathered into one complete state) or sharded (each card storing its own shard).
standard_en.effect: It sets StateDictOptions(full_state_dict=). full has rank0 gather a complete state with the same shape as single-GPU training; sharded has each rank store its own shard, which is smaller and faster to save but readable only by the DCP (torch.distributed.checkpoint) loader.
standard_en.whenToUse: full by default. Do not choose sharded unless you are certain the load side will use DCP and the card count will not change.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It has to be full when the artefact will go to single-GPU inference or be read with ordinary torch.load. A sharded artefact no longer lines up once the card count changes.

optionDescriptions.full: Gathers the shards into a complete state dict before saving (the default). The only form ordinary checkpoint loaders understand.
optionDescriptions.sharded: Each rank stores its own shard. Lower memory peak, but the artefact can only be read back through the DCP interface.

advanced.principle: 被 fully_shard 包过的模块，其 state_dict 里是 DTensor 而不是普通张量。full_state_dict=True 时 torch 的 get_model_state_dict 会做一次 all-gather 把它们还原成完整张量（默认还带 cpu_offload 落到主机内存）；False 时原样保留分片。broadcast_from_rank0 只在 full 下成立，sharded 下同时要求广播会被直接拒绝并说明原因。
advanced.intervention: distributed_runtime.py:_wrap_fsdp2 解析后写到 runtime.fsdp_state_dict_type 上；distributed_state.py 的四个 *_for_runtime 收集器从这个句柄上读，所以四条路径不改签名就一起跟着变。声明默认值在 2026-09-05 由 sharded 改成 full：这个键此前零读点，而所有实际跑过的代码路径都写死 full_state_dict=True —— 保留原声明会让这个键「一上线就把没动过设置的人静默切到分片产物」。
advanced.expectedImpact: full：保存时多一次 all-gather，产物与单卡同形状。sharded：保存快、单卡写入量小，产物只能被 DCP 读，且与卡数绑定。
advanced.tradeoffs: distributed_state.py 这四个收集器目前只有判据在调用，正式 checkpoint 路径走的是各家族自己的 state_dict_getter —— 也就是这个键在 FSDP2 状态收集 API 上已经活了，但主保存路径接上它是另一件待办。这条如实记在这里，而不是靠措辞含糊掩掉。

advanced_en.principle: A fully_shard-wrapped module's state_dict contains DTensors, not plain tensors. With full_state_dict=True, torch's get_model_state_dict does one all-gather to restore them to full tensors (defaulting to cpu_offload into host memory); False keeps the shards as-is. broadcast_from_rank0 only holds under full — requesting broadcast with sharded is rejected outright with an explanation.
advanced_en.intervention: distributed_runtime.py:_wrap_fsdp2 resolves the value onto runtime.fsdp_state_dict_type; the four *_for_runtime collectors in distributed_state.py read from that handle, so all four paths change together without signature changes. The declared default changed from sharded to full on 2026-09-05: this key previously had zero read points while every actually-executed code path hard-coded full_state_dict=True — keeping the old declaration would have meant the key "silently switched everyone who never touched the setting to sharded artifacts on day one".
advanced_en.expectedImpact: full: one extra all-gather on save, artifacts shaped like single-card ones. sharded: faster saves, smaller single-card writes, artifacts readable only by DCP and bound to the card count.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Those four collectors in distributed_state.py are currently only called by the criterion; the formal checkpoint path uses each family's own state_dict_getter — so this key is alive on the FSDP2 state-collection API, but wiring it into the main save path is separate pending work. Recorded here as-is rather than glossed over.
